app.name: Patient Records
app.description: Medical records for a plastic surgery practice

home.placeholder: Welcome, {name}. Today's appointments and surgeries will appear here once the calendar is connected.
home.waitingCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody is waiting.} one {# waiting for an earlier time.} other {# waiting for an earlier time.}} Open it from the "Waiting list" tile in the calendar.

errors.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.inactive: This account is suspended. Contact the administrator.

twoFactor.title: Verification code
twoFactor.intro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the 6-digit code.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
twoFactor.trust: Trust this device for {days} days (no verification code)
twoFactor.trustWarning: Only on your own device, never on a shared computer.
twoFactor.recoveryUsed: You used a recovery code. {left, plural, =0 {You have none left — ask the administrator for new codes.} one {# code left.} other {# codes left.}}

errors.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.expired: The login expired. Please start again.

setup2fa.title: Set up two-step verification
setup2fa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator).
setup2fa.step2: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code:
setup2fa.manual: Can't scan? Type this key instead:
setup2fa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app:
setup2fa.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, each code logs you in once. Save them now (print or password manager). They will not be shown again.
setup2fa.alreadyShown: The codes are shown only once and have already been shown.

invitation.subject: Invitation to Patient Records
invitation.body: {inviter} created an account for you in the practice's Patient Records. Use the link to choose a password and set up two-step verification:
invitation.expires: The link works once and expires in {hours} hours.
invitation.network: It only opens through the practice's private network (Tailscale).
invitation.ignore: If you did not expect this message, ignore it.

invite.title: Set up your account
invite.intro: Choose a password for {email}. Next you will set up two-step verification.
invite.generated: Your password — save it now (e.g. in a password manager):
invite.invalid: The link was already used or has expired. Ask the administrator to send a new one.

errors.too_short: The password must have at least {min} characters.
errors.invalid_link: The link is no longer valid.

form.name: Full name
form.method: How will the person get in?
form.methodPassword: Generate a password now (you hand it over)

levelHelp.OWNER: Everything. Can never be removed in the app.
levelHelp.ADMIN: Everything a User can, plus users, devices, settings.
levelHelp.USER: Day-to-day work with full patient access.
levelHelp.GUEST: Read-only, no contact details. Needs an end date.

form.roleHelp: Their job: decides the home screen, who verifies history and who appears as treating doctor. Grants no permissions — the level does.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.self: You cannot do this to yourself.
errors.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.
errors.guest_needs_end_date: A guest needs an end date in the future.
errors.not_invited: The user already has a password.

created.mailFailed: The user was created but the email was NOT sent. Try “Re-send invitation”.
created.password: The user's password — shown only now. Hand it over in person:

detail.resent: Invitation sent again. The old link no longer works.
detail.generateConfirm: The current password stops working and the user is logged out. Continue?
detail.reset2faConfirm: Removes their 2FA, trusted devices and logins. They set it up again at next login. Continue?
detail.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this user? This cannot be undone. Their activity history stays under “Deleted users”. To pause access, use “Suspend”.
detail.ownerProtected: Owners cannot be deleted, deactivated or demoted in the app.
detail.readOnlyOwner: Only an Owner can change an Owner's details.
detail.suspendConfirm: Suspend this account? The user is logged out at once and cannot log in. Everything is kept and you can reactivate them.

deleted.title: Deleted users
deleted.intro: These accounts were permanently deleted. Their activity history stays in the audit log.
deleted.name: Name

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every login and change, in Greek time. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.

backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: Every night at 02:30 the database is copied, checked with a test restore and encrypted. 14 daily, 8 weekly and 12 monthly copies are kept.
backups.stale: No successful backup in the last {hours} hours.
backups.never: No backup has been made yet.
backups.where: In the server's backups folder, encrypted. Opening them needs the private key, which is kept off the server.
backups.offsite: Off-site copy: set up at installation on the Synology (destination still to choose).

patients.title: Patients
patients.bigPlaceholder: Name, phone, AMKA, email or code P-…
patients.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
patients.suggestedSoon: They will appear here once the calendar is connected.
patients.recentNone: You have not opened a patient record yet.
patients.exportHint: Excel (CSV) file without names, contact details, AMKA or date of birth; research code instead of patient number. Logged.

search.label: Search patients
search.placeholder: Search patients — name, phone, email, AMKA

patient.archiveConfirm: Archive this patient? Hidden from search and lists. Nothing is deleted and it can be undone.
patient.flagHelp: Staff only. Write reasons factually — the patient may request them (GDPR).
patient.archived: This patient is archived: not shown in search or lists.

tabSoon.history: The full history by section, showing what the patient filled in and what was verified. Coming in the next step.
tabSoon.documents: Files, lab results and documents. Coming in a later step.

settings.usersText: Invite, levels, roles, suspend and delete users.
settings.devicesText: Logged-in and trusted devices per user.
settings.auditText: Who saw or changed what, and when.
settings.backupsText: Nightly encrypted backups and restore checks.
settings.listsText: Visit types, flag reasons, referral sources, marital status, tax offices.
settings.feesText: Which visit types are charged and how much.
settings.historyText: Questionnaire questions, sections, quick picks, sensitive and infection flags.
settings.proceduresText: Procedures by area and their sub-options.
settings.calendarText: Appointment types and lengths, columns and hours, blocked time (congresses, leave).

patientForm.newIntro: Registered in {company}. Before saving, the app checks for a possible duplicate.
patientForm.name: Name & birth

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.invalid_email: This email is not valid (e.g. name@example.com).
errors.invalid_phone: A phone number is too short.
errors.invalid_birth_date: The date of birth is not valid.
errors.invalid_choice: A choice is no longer available; reload the page.

duplicates.title: {count, plural, one {Possible duplicate found} other {# possible duplicates found}}
duplicates.introCreate: The patient may have been here before. Check before creating a new record. Shared phones/emails in families are normal.
duplicates.introEdit: The new details match another record. If it is not the same person, save normally.

reasons.first_name_dob: same first name and birth date

duplicates.mergeIntro: Choose which value to keep for each field. Fields missing from the existing record are filled from what you typed.
duplicates.mergeNote: No new record is created. Every change is logged.
duplicates.createAnyway: Not the same — create new patient

history.empty: No medical history has been filled in for this patient yet.
history.unanswered: {count, plural, one {# not answered} other {# not answered}}

errors.invalid: Something went wrong; please try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.not_verifier: Only a surgeon or PA/nurse can verify.

history.allNoHelp: Unanswered items become No; answered ones do not change.

visit.planningSoon: Surgical planning (pen sketches, measurements) comes with surgeries (Phase 4).
visit.weightPrompt: Weigh the patient — weight is recorded at every visit.
visit.chargeAfterSave: The fee is entered after the visit is saved.

errors.invalid_value: A value is not right (e.g. weight, blood pressure, pulse or amount).
errors.invalid_date: The date or time is not right (dd/mm/yyyy and HH:MM).
errors.invalid: Something went wrong; please try again.

documents.choose: Choose files or drop them here
documents.allowed: PDF, images (JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC), Word, Excel · up to 25 MB each
documents.name: Name
documents.saved: {count, plural, one {1 document saved.} other {# documents saved.}}
documents.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”? Only the Owner can restore it.

errors.too_many: Up to 20 files at a time.
errors.bad_type: “{file}” is not a PDF, image, Word or Excel file.
errors.invalid_value: Check the date and the visit.
errors.demo: The test version does not store files. Uploads work in the real app.

settingsLists.title: Lists
settingsLists.forCompany: For: {company}. Each company has its own lists.
settingsLists.name: Name
settingsLists.note: Choices are never deleted because records use them. Hiding removes them from new choices only; renaming also changes existing records.

help.VISIT_TYPE: The "Visit type" list. Fees are set by the front desk under "Visit fees".
help.FLAG_REASON: Reasons in a patient's flag (yellow / red).
help.CHAT_PRESET_STAFF: The assistant's and front desk's one-tap chat messages.

errors.duplicate: A choice with this name already exists.

settingsFees.title: Visit fees
settingsFees.intro: For: {company}. Which visit types are charged and how much. The amount fills in on a new visit and can be changed per visit.
settingsFees.note: Amounts are never shown to the surgeon.

errors.invalid_value: Enter an amount in euros (e.g. 100) for charged types.

settingsHistory.title: Medical history
settingsHistory.intro: For: {company}. The questionnaire's questions, in the order the form shows them, and their quick picks. Questions and picks are never deleted; hiding takes them off the form and old answers stay.

flags.infection: Infection (a verified Yes shows as an alert)

settingsHistory.pickCount: {count, plural, =0 {no picks} one {1 pick} other {# picks}}

settingsProcedures.title: Procedures
settingsProcedures.intro: For: {company}. The procedures of the preoperative assessment, by area, with their sub-options. Never deleted; hiding removes them from new visits, old visits keep them.

errors.duplicate: A procedure with this name already exists.

settingsCalendar.title: Calendar
settingsCalendar.intro: For: {company}. Practice and Spa have separate calendars.

help.types: Colour, length and calendar layer of each type. The length fills in on a new appointment.
help.resources: The calendar's columns (doctor, nurse, operating room, cabins) and their hours. Outside the hours the calendar warns.
help.blocks: Congress, leave, break: no appointments. Public holidays are worked out automatically.
help.hours: The calendar's hours rules. Changes apply at once and are logged.

errors.invalid_value: Check the details (name, length 5–720′, times HH:MM, dates DD/MM/YYYY).

rules.officeHelp: Per doctor / nurse. Only these count as "free" and for the "full >10 days" rule.
rules.flexHelp: Minutes before and after office hours that staff can book with one extra click. Online booking never offers them. Anything else outside hours needs a reason.
rules.surgeryHelp: Surgeries go in this window; after its end a reason is needed. Shown as the compact top band of the calendar.
rules.weekend: Saturday and Sunday: closed and hidden. "+ Sat/Sun" in the calendar shows them; a booking there needs a reason.
rules.cancelHelp: Closer than these hours = late cancellation (yellow flag). A second one within these months = red.

settingsCalendar.forNewPatients: For new patients (set automatically; not offered to existing ones)

calendar.subtitle: Front desk · day
calendar.columnSummary: {surgeries, plural, =0 {} one {# surgery · } other {# surgeries · }}{count} appointments · {free} free
calendar.requestsSoon: From online booking (high value, full > 10 days, collision): come with the GHL link (6d).
calendar.otherDay: You are looking at another day than today.
calendar.reasonHint: e.g. breast, second opinion — no medical notes

move.notMovedHint: For an exception with a reason: open the appointment → "By hand".
move.carryHint: Drop it on a free time (any day, week or month) · Esc = cancel
move.label: Move
move.parkedNote: It stays over the other appointment until room is made or its time changes.

errors.forbidden: Not allowed (payment is recorded by the front desk or PA).
errors.not_allowed: This step is not possible from the current status.
errors.reason_needed: Write a reason for booking outside office hours.

calendar.fullBannerText: Online booking will show no times; new requests come to you (with GHL, 6d).

subtitleDoctor.day: My schedule · surgery mornings, office afternoons

calendar.noOwnColumn: No doctor column found for you: link it in Settings → Calendar → Resources.

problems.patient: The patient already has an appointment {from}–{to} ({label})
problems.flex: Outside hours +30′ (just before or after hours)

calendar.flexNote: Flex zone just before or after office hours: booked with one extra click. Online booking never offers it.
calendar.weekendNote: Weekends hidden (closed). "+ Sat/Sun" shows them for exceptions.

quick.cannotNotify: no confirmation is sent; shows in "Confirmations tomorrow" as "can't be notified".

arrival.title: Arrival · check details
arrival.mergeLater: Check before going on — it may be the same person.
arrival.logged: The correction is logged with the old and new value.

calendar.parkedHint: Overlaps another appointment: make room or change its time.

cancel.title: Cancel — never deleted
cancel.intro: It leaves the calendar ("Show cancelled" brings it back) and stays in the history for good. The flag is set automatically; it is changed on the patient record, with a reason.

hints.cancel: in time (≥ {hours} h before) · no flag

cancel.lateRule: A 2nd late one within {months} months → red.
cancel.secondLate: Already a late cancellation within {months} months → this one gives red.
cancel.matchesNote: The time is offered to the waiting list ({count} fit).
cancel.offer: {count} on the waiting list fit the time:
cancel.whatsappLater: WhatsApp offers to several at once: with GHL (6d/6e).
cancel.noMatches: Nobody on the waiting list fits this time.

errors.not_allowed: Not allowed from the current status.

waitlist.error: Check the patient, days and times (HH:MM).

fromRecord.menuHint: Type → opens the calendar with the card "in hand"
fromRecord.hint: Click a free time (any week or month) · Esc = back to the record

bubble.hint: Click a free time · Esc = cancel, they keep waiting
